ModMetaData.name: Aragorn – Armee der Toten (Entwicklungsstand)
ModMetaData.author: Aragorn Mod Project
ModMetaData.description: Version 0.17: Nine installed Gizmo icons, including a Dev-only complete-Aragorn-quests button; bespoke silver-blue Anduril world/inventory sprite; Aragorn gains the vanilla GreatMemory trait; all 13 directional spectral pawn sprites are approximately eight percent larger. Real equipped spirit weapons remain mechanically functional but the redundant second world-drawn weapon is suppressed, because these original three-direction sprites already show their own weapons. English and German story quests and Divine Order smith dialogue from 0.15 remain included. Test on a copy of your save.
